title: Karbobala naseeb se jaana naseeb ho
body:
Karbobala naseeb se jaana naseeb ho
Karbobalaa naseeb se jaanaa naseeb ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir lauT ke wahaaN se na aanaa naseeb ho
Aisaa dar e hussain pe sajdaa ho aakhri
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir mujhko apnaa sar na uthaanaa naseeb ho
Parvardigaar
<<DIVIDER>>
thokareN dar dar ki kab talak
Kab mustaqil najaf meN Thikaanaa naseeb ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Jaisaa milaa naseeb se ummul baneen ko
Ab kyaa kisi ko aisaa gharaanaa naseeb ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil chaahtaa hai saamne baithey ho panjetan
Unki sanaa unhi ko sunaanaa naseeb ho
<<DIVIDER>>
AaNkhoN ko jab bhi ashq bahaanaa naseeb ho
Aal e nabi ke gham kaa bahaanaa naseeb ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehshar ye aarzoo hai ki be ghusl o be kafan
Karbobalaa ki teh meN samaanaa naseeb ho
author: Mir Hassan Mir
